_note: Trophy cabinet data. Empty until results are supplied. Every page that reads it hides itself while this list is empty, so an empty file costs nothing — a stale one costs plenty.
_slugs: 'competition' and 'discipline' MUST match slugs in competitions.json. The build fails on an unmatched slug rather than silently rendering a broken filter. Competition slugs are matched without their edition year: 'tubc' matches 'tubc-2026'.
_discipline: Optional. Internationals are single-case events with no discipline breakdown — omit it or set null there.
_placement: 1, 2, or 3 for podium. Strings 'finalist' or 'honourable' also accepted if awarded. Only 1-2-3 count toward the podium totals.
_photo: Optional per season: a key from src/data/photos.ts, shown as that season's band. Validated at build.
_no_names: Deliberately no delegate names. Listing individuals needs consent from every person and dates badly as rosters turn over. Results stay institutional.
_maintenance: This is the only part of the site with a standing annual obligation. Add results after each season. A cabinet whose newest entry is two years old is worse than none. Belongs in the VP Academics handover, not VP Tech's.
